caption: The drawing depicts two renderings of the same object, a ladle with a long, straight handle and a deep, rounded bowl. The upper rendering is a monochromatic, pencil-drawn outline and shaded study of the ladle, focusing on its form and surface details. The lower rendering is more detailed and in color, showing the handle in shades of brown with subtle highlights, and the bowl in a mix of yellow, green, and brown tones, depicting a metallic or enamel-like surface with suggestions of iridescence. The background is a plain, light beige paper with some visible discoloration and faint stains. Near the bowl of the ladle in the colored rendering, the name “Chas F. Moss” and the year “93” are written in red ink. Both versions of the ladle are oriented horizontally with the bowl on the left and the handle extending to the right.
title: Ladle
